No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5). [1] The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).

paragraphs.text: Counterfeit relations, refused one by one: awaiting smuggles in the mind it needs; two-seatedness describes addresses, not bonds; uninterruptedness would marry iron bars. All declined.

What stands: form-fusion, the manys one-selfhood. And the opponents proof-text testifies against itself — unmixed things thought-joined turns out to be unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable inside recognition. Their own verse convicts them.

No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11). [1] Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).

paragraphs.text: Unity costs the consciousness-bodied nothing. The worldly ones reflection-object is locked: difference-pithed non-difference-shining. That is the setup.

Then the joinery: one thought, un-touched by others. One word — pot-cloth — uniting many. A helping qualifier-qualified relation, admitted because it serves knowledge. Twoness inside manyness, double-reflection-born, like the kings retinue.
Two facings, king and man. Three thinkings. The genitive settles in the qualifier, reaches qualified-oneness, keeps its own form. Nothing lost in the joining.
